units.source_text: “那位太太也是把行李全部集中起来，从京都出来的。

en.t: That lady, too, gathered all her luggage together and came out from Kyoto.

units.source_text: 但她昨天终于在店里哭了。

en.t: But yesterday she finally cried in the shop.

units.source_text: 因为她已经到处转悠了整整四天。”

en.t: Because she had already been wandering around everywhere for four whole days.
